mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COURSE WHERE STATUS = 'Y'

SELECT COURSE_ID AS courseId, COURSE_TITLE AS courseTitle, DESCRIPTION AS description, MEMBER_ID AS memberId, STATUS AS status, START_DATE AS startDate, END_DATE AS endDate, TOTAL_HOURS AS totalHours, CREATE_DATE AS createDate, UPDATED_DATE AS updatedDate FROM COURSE WHERE STATUS = 'Y'
AND ( COURSE_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR DESCRIPTION LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY CREATE_DATE ASC
ORDER BY CREATE_DATE DESC
